contentPattern: Optional first row, 1 cell: question heading (h2) and intro text. Then 1 row per option, 2 cells: option label (plain text) | answer content (paragraphs, links, CTA link). Optional trailing row(s), 1 cell: content appended below every answer. Choosing an option (toggle button, aria-pressed) reveals its answer in an aria-live region; nothing is fetched. The question heading may instead be default content above the block.
